run_stress_test: run a gRPC stress test client against specified server addresses with configurable test cases
parse_weighted_test_cases: parse a comma separated list of test case names and weights into a dictionary
get_grpc_channel: create a gRPC channel to a target server with optional TLS and test CA support
configure_test_arguments: configure command line arguments for the gRPC stress test client including server addresses and test duration
start_metrics_server: start a gRPC metrics server on a specified port to collect histogram data from test runners
